hero.title: Work Better. Dream Bigger.
hero.subtitle: Nexa Workspace provides premium, intelligently-designed physical offices and meeting rooms for teams that demand excellence.

services.title: Private Offices
services.shortDesc: Fully furnished, acoustically treated private suites for teams of 2 to 50.
services.longDesc: Our private offices are designed for maximum productivity and privacy. Featuring ergonomic Herman Miller seating, sit-stand desks, and sound-dampening glass, these suites are perfect for focused deep work. Includes 24/7 access and unlimited premium coffee.

services.title: Dedicated Desks
services.shortDesc: Your own permanent desk in our beautifully designed open-plan coworking areas.
services.longDesc: Leave your monitors and personal items securely overnight. Dedicated desks provide the perfect balance between community networking and consistent routine. Includes lockable filing cabinets and access to phone booths.

services.title: Executive Meeting Rooms
services.shortDesc: State-of-the-art conference rooms equipped with 4K screens and Zoom Rooms integration.
services.longDesc: Impress your clients in our executive boardrooms. Fully equipped with wireless casting, dual 4K monitors, high-fidelity acoustic arrays, and whiteboards. Catering services available upon request.

services.title: Event & Lounge Spaces
services.shortDesc: Expansive, beautifully lit areas perfect for networking events, panels, and parties.
services.longDesc: Host up to 200 guests in our premium lounge areas. Featuring a built-in sound system, modular staging, and an espresso bar. Our community team will help you coordinate catering and logistics.

services.title: Virtual Office & Mail
services.shortDesc: A prestigious business address and professional mail handling services.
services.longDesc: Establish your presence in tier-1 business districts without the physical overhead. We handle your physical mail, forward packages, and provide a professional receptionist to greet your occasional guests.

services.title: Enterprise Custom Suites
services.shortDesc: Full floor build-outs customized specifically for your company's brand and culture.
services.longDesc: For teams of 50+, we offer completely custom headquarters. From private entrances to custom IT infrastructure and bespoke interior design, we handle the entire real estate lifecycle so you can focus on your business.

faqs.question: When can I access my workspace?
faqs.answer: Dedicated Desk and Private Office members have 24/7 access to their home locations. Hot Desk members can access the space during standard business hours (8 AM - 6 PM, Mon-Fri).

faqs.question: Are meeting room credits included?
faqs.answer: Yes, all memberships include a monthly allotment of meeting room credits. Additional credits can be purchased seamlessly through the member portal.

faqs.question: Can I use other Nexa Workspace locations when traveling?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Private Office and Dedicated Desk members get a "Global Pass" which allows up to 5 days of Hot Desk access per month at any Nexa Workspace location worldwide.

faqs.question: Do you offer custom build-outs for large teams?
faqs.answer: Yes, our Enterprise Suites are entirely customizable. Our internal architecture team will work with you to design a layout, branding, and IT setup that fits your exact needs.
